title.zh: PancakeSwap核心团队在治理论坛提出"The Flip"提案：LP分成升至88%，CAKE排放削减约69%
title.en: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission

current_state.zh: “The Flip”提案已从治理论坛提议阶段进入治理投票阶段，投票截至 2026 年 10 月 24 日；若通过，预计 11 月起实施。PancakeSwap TVL 同期升至约 24 亿美元。
current_state.en: 'The Flip' has moved from a governance-forum proposal to an active governance vote running until Oct. 24, 2026; if approved, implementation is expected from November. PancakeSwap TVL rose to about $2.4 billion over the same period.

updates.title_zh: PancakeSwap提议将LP费用分成提高至88%并削减每日CAKE发行量
updates.title_en: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission
updates.what_changed_zh: PancakeSwap 的 Kitchen 提议将全部 11 条链上 v3 和 Infinity swap 费用的 LP 分成提高至 88%，并将每日 CAKE 排放量从 22,500 枚削减约 69% 至 7,000 枚，该提案有待 Snapshot 投票，实施目标为 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月。
updates.what_changed_en: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: PancakeSwap 的 Kitchen 提议将全部 11 条链上 v3 和 Infinity swap 费用的 LP 分成提高至 88%，并将每日 CAKE 排放量从 22,500 枚削减约 69% 至 7,000 枚，该提案有待 Snapshot 投票，实施目标为 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月。
updates.current_state_en: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.

updates.detailed_summary_en: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.

updates.title_zh: 【PancakeSwap 拟将 LP 手续费分成提至 88%，并大幅削减 CAKE 日增发量】
updates.title_en: 【PancakeSwap 拟将 LP 手续费分成提至 88%，并大幅削减 CAKE 日增发量】
updates.what_changed_zh: 提案细节进一步明确：协议费降至12%并归入国库，v2保持不变；每日7000枚CAKE排放全部划入新设立的生态增长基金Pantry，用于营销、合作及新池子引导；基于2025年交易量测算LP将多获得约6200万美元手续费；CAKE通缩仍按Tokenomics 3.0推进。
updates.what_changed_en: Proposal details further specified: protocol fee reduced to 12% and directed to treasury, v2 unchanged; all 7,000 daily CAKE emissions to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund for marketing, partnerships, and new pool bootstrapping; LPs estimated to gain ~$62M more in fees based on 2025 volume; CAKE deflation remains on Tokenomics 3.0 track.
updates.current_state_zh: PancakeSwap团队已提出将v3与Infinity池LP手续费分成提升至88%、协议费降至12%并归入国库，覆盖全部11条链，v2不变；同时将每日CAKE排放削减约69%至7000枚并全部划入新生态增长基金Pantry，待治理流程推进。
updates.current_state_en: PancakeSwap team has proposed raising LP fee share to 88% on v3 and Infinity pools, reducing protocol fee to 12% directed to treasury across all 11 chains with v2 unchanged, and cutting daily CAKE emissions by ~69% to 7,000 tokens directed to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund, pending governance process.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: PancakeSwap's team proposed raising LP fee share to 88% on v3 and Infinity pools across 11 chains while cutting daily CAKE emissions by about 69% to 7,000 tokens directed to a new Pantry ecosystem growth fund.
updates.detailed_summary_en: PancakeSwap's team proposed raising LP fee share to 88% on v3 and Infinity pools across 11 chains while cutting daily CAKE emissions by about 69% to 7,000 tokens directed to a new Pantry ecosystem growth fund.

updates.title_zh: PancakeSwap TVL 突破 3.8 亿美元，重大费用改革即将投票
updates.title_en: PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
updates.what_changed_zh: PancakeSwap 已于 2026 年 10 月 21 日就“The Flip”提案开启治理投票，投票持续至 10 月 24 日；若获批，预计 11 月开始实施。同期 PancakeSwap TVL 上升约 19% 至约 24 亿美元，V3 池 TVL 从约 3.36 亿美元增至约 7.39 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: PancakeSwap opened a governance vote on 'The Flip' on Oct. 21, 2026, running through Oct. 24, with implementation expected to begin in November if approved. Over the same period, PancakeSwap TVL rose about 19% to roughly $2.4 billion, with V3 pool TVL increasing from about $336 million to about $739 million.
updates.current_state_zh: “The Flip”提案已从治理论坛提议阶段进入治理投票阶段，投票截至 2026 年 10 月 24 日；若通过，预计 11 月起实施。PancakeSwap TVL 同期升至约 24 亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: 'The Flip' has moved from a governance-forum proposal to an active governance vote running until Oct. 24, 2026; if approved, implementation is expected from November. PancakeSwap TVL rose to about $2.4 billion over the same period.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: PancakeSwap's TVL rose ~19% to $2.4B as the protocol opened a governance vote on 'The Flip', which would lift liquidity providers' share of swap fees to 88% and cut CAKE emissions by 69%.
updates.detailed_summary_en: PancakeSwap's TVL rose ~19% to $2.4B as the protocol opened a governance vote on 'The Flip', which would lift liquidity providers' share of swap fees to 88% and cut CAKE emissions by 69%.
